lokele: Imi Wange w’Etanda, nd’asosɔnɔ lokasa-lo ende botomali wa elame oyaaomu la Mungu, la ende bana bande, ebasamomu lami batotina la wewe; la inga ko lami kongo, kangä imɔ ko la batoti ebaluwi njasɔ ya wewe,
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

lokele: ko l’eoka ya wewe eboyali nda betema yasu la ebokayaleke imɔ lasu ko layalaya.
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

lokele: Booto la shota la lilatemi ya Mungu Sango la Yesu Masiya ako Wana wa Sango, biyaleke lasu nda wewe la losamɔ! Tokɛndɛlɛkɛ la lilitesi nda losamɔ
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, 1:3 the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

lokele: Isokaka limɛngɔ finɛ eoka isoosha bamɔi ba bana baɛ batokɛndɛlɛ ko nda wewe, kwa atelomoko iso ekela ko la Sango.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

lokele: La kwani, Botomali wa elame, isömb’aɛ ing’imɔ ndosɔnɛl’aɛ ekela eyai, kangä ko yao eyaaka lasu ko nda liako, eko mbo tosamaneke.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

lokele: La losamɔ lona lole ngo ko mbo tokɛndɛlɛkɛ ko nda bikela yande; ekela ena, kwa okakä ino ko nda liako, mbo okɛndɛlɛkɛ nda losamɔ.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

lokele: Eoka balimbakeli wike basokakɛndɛkɛ nda wenda-bo, bato ebaitoaola mbo Yesu Masiya asoya nda bindo ya boto. Bɔfɔnɔ-bo ale bolimbakeli la bofekwani la Masiya.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

lokele: Lambaka betema yanu, mbo otalefesa yao ebisokuwel’ino, kangä mbo bɔɔlɛkɛ bondanda ebosɔɔlwa.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

lokele: Boto oyatoetela oso, angokɔkɔmɔ ko nda liekesi lia Masiya, ambo ona atiyale la Mungu; nde oyasokɔkɔmɔ nda liekesi, ambo ona asoyala la Sango la Wana.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

lokele: Boto eya end’ino ani atieshe liekesi-li, ɔtɛsɛ̈k’inde nda ndakɔ, oseelëk’inde!
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

lokele: Eoka boto oyatoseel’inde, ambo asosangana lande nda bekeeli bibe yande.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

lokele: Ile la njasɔ wike yoonga lanu, nde itiangosɔnɔ la lokasa la wino kongo ko yende la iɛli shoyɛn’ino la ndoongana lanu l’ɔmbo l’ɔmbɔ, mbo limɛngɔ lianu liɔlwɛkɛ.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

lokele: Bana ba etungani yaɛ etomali oyasoaomo basoseel’aɛ.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
